data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Mattiyahu, meaning 'gift of God'. In the New Testament, Mathias was one of the twelve apostles who replaced Judas Iscariot. The name Mathias carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mathias usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with divine grace and blessings.
data.etymology: Mathias belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mathias total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: מתיאס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מתיאס הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'מתנת אלוהים' או 'מתתיהו'. השם מתקשר לשם העברי 'מתתיהו' שמקורו בימי בית שני. מתיאס היה אחד משנים עשר השליחים של ישוע המשיח, שנבחר אחרי בגידתו של יהודה איש קריות. הוא מוזכר בספר מעשי השליחים ונקשר לאירועים חשובים בתולדות הקהילה הנוצרית הראשונית.

in_greek.name: Ματθίας
in_greek.long_meaning: Ματθίας είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος 'מתתיהו' (מתיאס), που σημαίνει 'δώρο του Θεού'. Στο Καινή Διαθήκη, ο Ματθίας αναφέρεται ως ένας από τους δώδεκα αποστόλους του Ιησού Χριστού, εκλεγμένος να πάρει τη θέση του Ιούδα Ισκαριώτη. Το όνομα αυτό διατηρήθηκε στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας και χρησιμοποιήθηκε σε πολλές χριστιανικές κοινότητες.

in_latin.name: Mathias
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Mathias a voce hebraea 'מתתיהו' (Matthaeus) derivatur, quod 'donum Dei' significat. In Ecclesia primitiva, Mathias apostolus fuit, qui pro Juda Iscariote electus est. Nomen hoc ad traditionem Christianam pertinet et in variis formis in linguas diversas translatum est.

in_english.name: Mathias
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mathias originates from the Hebrew 'מתתיהו' (Mattathias), meaning 'gift of God' or 'divine gift'. It is associated with Matthias, one of Jesus Christ's twelve apostles, chosen to replace Judas Iscariot after his betrayal. This name has been significant in Christian tradition, symbolizing divine favor and spiritual leadership. Historically, the name Mathias has been used across various Christian cultures, reflecting its biblical roots and enduring spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mathias has been popular across various Christian communities throughout history, and it represents the idea of being divinely chosen or favored by God. This name has a rich and enduring legacy, evoking images of faith, dedication, and divine grace.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Mathias lies in its symbolism as a reminder of God's provision and divine intervention. It is a name that encourages one to trust in God's plan and to believe that He will always provide a replacement or solution when needed. Additionally, Mathias is a name that reflects the humility and obedience of the apostle who bore this name, as he was chosen by God to replace Judas Iscariot and carry on the mission of spreading the Gospel.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mathias, derived from the Hebrew name Mattiyas, means "gift of God." This name is given to remind us of the divine origin of our lives and the blessings bestowed upon us by God.

biblical_reference.note: Matthias was chosen as an apostle to replace Judas Iscariot.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mathias was a disciple of Jesus in the New Testament. The name Mathias carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
Saint Mathias is mentioned in the Acts of the Apostles as being chosen to replace Judas Iscariot among the Twelve Apostles.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Mathias remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Michael Mathias in Athens, Greece credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Mathias, which means "Gift of God". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
